name.description: The name of the PolarDBX instance.

i18n.en-US: The name of the PolarDB-X instance.

instance_id.description: The ID of an existing PolarDBX instance. If set, no new instance will be created.

i18n.zh-Hans: 现有PolarDBX实例的ID。如果设置了该参数，则不会创建新实例。
i18n.en-US: The ID of an existing PolarDB-X instance. If specified, no new instance will be created.

engine_version.description: The database engine version. Valid values: 5.7, 8.0.

i18n.en-US: The database engine version. Valid values: 5.7, 8.0.

storage.description: The storage size of the instance in GB.

i18n.en-US: The storage size of the instance in GB.

vswitch_id.description: The ID of the VSwitch for network configuration.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于网络配置的交换机ID。
i18n.en-US: The ID of the VSwitch used for network configuration.

description.description: The description of the PolarDBX instance.

i18n.en-US: The description of the PolarDB-X instance.

databases.description: Map of databases to create. Key is database name, value is database configuration.

i18n.zh-Hans: 要创建的数据库映射表。键为数据库名称，值为数据库配置。
i18n.en-US: Map of databases to create. The key is the database name, and the value is the database configuration.

accounts.description: Map of accounts to create. Key is account name, value is account configuration.

i18n.zh-Hans: 要创建的账户映射表。键为账户名称，值为账户配置。
i18n.en-US: Map of accounts to create. Key is account name, value is account configuration.

use_account_database_binding.description: Whether to use alibabacloudstack_polardbx_account_database_binding resource for account privileges.

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否使用 alibabacloudstack_polardbx_account_database_binding 资源来管理账号权限。
i18n.en-US: Whether to use the alibabacloudstack_polardbx_account_database_binding resource for account privileges.

enable_backup.description: Whether to trigger a one-time manual backup for the PolarDBX instance. When true, a single manual backup is initiated after the instance is available.

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否为 PolarDB-X 实例触发一次手动备份。设为 true 时，将在实例可用后发起一次手动备份。
i18n.en-US: Whether to trigger a one-time manual backup for the PolarDB-X instance. When true, a single manual backup is initiated after the instance is available.

backup_type.description: The type of the manual backup. Valid values: 0 (physical backup). Only used when enable_backup is true.

i18n.zh-Hans: 手动备份的类型。有效值：0（物理备份）。仅在 enable_backup 为 true 时生效。
i18n.en-US: The type of the manual backup. Valid values: 0 (physical backup). Only used when enable_backup is true.
